effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
＜Vortex＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.)
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any Digimon suspend, this Digimon may unsuspend.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, for every 2 suspended Digimon, you may return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
